QuestInfo.name: [Chu Chu] A Taste of Skywhale Mountain 2
QuestInfo.0: Pidol is the youngest of the Pi siblings. He's not all there, but he seems to know everything about high-flying ingredients. Get Pidol's help to complete the 'egg patty.'
QuestInfo.1: Pidol is the youngest of the Pi siblings. He's not all there, but he seems to know everything about high-flying ingredients. Get Pidol's help to locate some seasoning.\r\n\r\nPidol tells you to get Unpleasant Talons from Birdsharks and Chewy Talons from Patriarch Birdshark.
QuestInfo.2: Pidol really pulled through! You put the finishing touches on the "egg patty" with his help. This whole thing looks kind of insane... but all that matters is how it tastes.

default.0: Didn't... you... bring... them... yet? Too... slow...
